parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning they share only the structural shape of being zero-field type aliases — not any shared semantic content. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit) each encode a distinct domain event in unrelated subsystems. Collapsing them into a single shared type would conflate unrelated message semantics and break the intentional domain boundaries between the Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit packages. The `shared_field_count: 1` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` confirms the only commonality is the empty-body shape, not any real structural overlap.
